attempts.evaluation: The generator ignored 'turret only' and produced a complete small tank as ONE mesh (hull, tracks and turret fused), 3.6 x 5.3 studs instead of 8 x 22, and the baked texture did not load in the editor (flat grey). Cannot be split into components; rejected.

attempts.promptVariant: lower hull with tracks only, segmentation none, size 18x6x27
attempts.evaluation: Again a complete textured tank as one fused mesh (7.4 x 11 studs, far under the requested 18 x 27). Good silhouette but no separable turret or tracks, so component damage could not be shown on it. Rejected as a skin; prompt changed to request the complete vehicle with explicit parts.

attempts.promptVariant: complete tank, segmentation explicit, partNames hull / turret and gun / left track / right track
attempts.evaluation: Inspected in Studio next to the proving ground: a convincing four-part tank (hull with glacis, fenders, engine deck; wide cast turret with cupola, bustle and long gun with muzzle brake; two tracks with road wheels and cleats). Came out 11.5 wide x 17.1 long (requested 16 x 28), so it is scaled 1.55x at placement. Gun faces -Z. Palette is a pale olive-grey baked texture; MeshPart.Color does not tint it (as documented in assets/README.md), so wreck states clear the texture and apply a charred colour, and intermediate damage uses server scorch discs. Accepted.
